hooks.command: sh -c 'cards=$(find .claude/tasks/inprogress .claude/tasks/inreview -name "*.md" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$cards" ]; then echo "[task board] unfinished cards — a gated run was interrupted:"; echo "$cards"; echo "Ask to resume: reconcile every card against git before acting on it (AGENTS.md, Resume an interrupted run)."; fi; exit 0'
